name: Plan Card with Billing Toggle
description: One plan card under a gliding billing switch: blocks rise from blur, slot-reel digits spin up from zero, the total counts and checks draw in. Monochrome.

props.name: monthly
props.description: Price per seat per month on monthly billing.

props.name: annual
props.description: Price per seat per month on annual billing.

props.name: description
props.description: One line on who the plan is for.

props.name: unit
props.description: Small print beside the price; \n splits it over two lines.

props.name: saveLabel
props.description: Badge that springs in on annual billing, in the accent.

props.name: notes
props.description: Billing note under the price; cross-fades on toggle.

props.name: features
props.description: Feature list; each check draws in after its row lands.

props.name: cta / ctaDone
props.description: CTA label and its success label.

props.name: onCheckout
props.description: CTA handler. Return a promise for the loading state.

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats stepper and tweened total. false hides it.

props.name: footnote
props.default: "Prices in USD. Tax added at checkout."
props.description: Mono small print at the bottom.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour, used only on the save badge.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.
